title: I Love Monday.com
subtitle: A literal Ode to project management
body_html:
The Frontier Psychiatrists is a health-themed newsletter. It’s also a low-key media empire. Today, Owen Scott Muir, M.D., the proprietor of this publication, is thrilled to announce his new no-so-hit parody single, “Monday.com”

Subscribe now

Monday is project management software. It has an API. It can sign a business associate agreement to be compliant with HIPAA. It is really good. It is so good that I recorded a parody cover of the Chris Isaak classic tune “Wicked Game.”

The tools we use to get things done in healthcare? They Matter. The stethoscope, the electronic health record, medicines, the MRI, the SAINT neuromodulation system. Spruce Health! I love Spruce Health so much that I’ve flown to conferences to talk about how great it is…and I don’t work there!

Monday.com is a great product. So this is my parody song about how great Monday is…recorded live—in one take— to 24-track tape at the Tiny Telephone in San Francisco.
